subject: Coordination: Pinebrook advisory call for analyst inquiry — timing & redlines

From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@gartner.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>; Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@pinebrookhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0500
Subject: Analyst advisory call for Pinebrook Health — request

Hi Hannah / Elena,

I’m working on a short advisory note about inference platforms for healthcare workloads and Pinebrook was suggested as a potential customer reference. Would Pinebrook be open to a 30-minute call with me to discuss how you’re using Redwood’s Dedicated offering (latency SLAs, private deployment, and auditability)? The goal is a neutral analyst briefing — high level, non-attributable unless you approve quotes.

If yes, a few logistics/questions:
- Preferred windows in the next two weeks (CDT timezone)
- Any procurement/legal contacts I should loop in for standard confidentiality / NDA checks
- Any redlines or topics Pinebrook doesn’t want recorded (e.g., unit economics, detailed architecture diagrams)

Thanks — Tom
Tom Reed
Senior Research Analyst, Infrastructure Platforms
Gartner
